To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
GARLIC provides an accurate and efficient method for inferring ROHis from whole‐genome SNP data and for identifying biologically meaningful ROH classes.

1) GARLIC is a fast and accurate software tool for inferring runs of homozygous (ROH) in genome-wide SNP datasets; 2) GARLIC provides a length-based classification module to identify ROH of interest; 3) the length-based classification module is able to identify ROH that are likely to be caused by recent inbreeding; and 4) GARLIC is able to identify the ROH that are most likely to harbor disease-causing mutations.
